what: Committed trust anchors for the bench100 accuracy floor gate (dev-docs/bench/scripts/bench100_gate.py). The corpus, the ground truth and the frozen baseline are license-encumbered or local-only and stay gitignored; their HASHES are not, and committing the hashes is what gives the gate an external reference to verify against. Every run compares the live baseline to this file and exits 2 on any mismatch.
how_to_verify: python dev-docs/bench/scripts/bench100_gate.py --rescore   # exits 2 on any mismatch with this file. If it disagrees, `git diff accuracy/bench100_anchors.json` shows what someone changed; a legitimate move arrives as a reviewed diff to this file in the same commit as the phase that earned it.
